+def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> set[str]:
+    """Return extra filename suffixes for MIME types in ``upstream_mimetypes``.
+
+    Qt misses some suffixes for MIME types in affected versions. This helper
+    resolves those suffixes without depending on a page instance.
+    """
+    # Check the Qt version before inspecting MIME entries: outside this range
+    # the workaround must be a no-op.
+    if not (qtutils.version_check("6.2.3") and not qtutils.version_check("6.7.0")):
+        return set()
+
+    entries = list(upstream_mimetypes)
+    suffixes = {entry for entry in entries if entry.startswith(".")}
+    mimes = {entry for entry in entries if "/" in entry}
+    python_suffixes = set()
+    for mime in mimes:
+        if mime.endswith("/*"):
+            python_suffixes.update(
+                suffix
+                for suffix, mimetype in mimetypes.types_map.items()
+                if mimetype.startswith(mime[:-1])
+            )
+        else:
+            python_suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
+    return python_suffixes - suffixes
+
